Watermark Lab 2.2.0

What's new:
- Play video previews on a silent loop to see the watermark in motion.
- Page through PDF and Word previews - not just the first page.
- Much smaller exported PDFs (screen-optimised).
- Smart handling of protected files: labelled PowerPoint/Word still watermark with the label preserved, while protected PDFs and DRM-protected videos are detected and clearly flagged.

Upgrading: click Yes when prompted; your presets and recent files are kept.
